raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and marking requirements for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts under the EAR. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and pistols (HTS 9302/9303) should re-verify ECCN classification, license exception eligibility, and end-use/end-user controls. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment still apply to China-origin goods, and Entity List/restricted party screening remains mandatory. Reassess prior license applications and update compliance procedures to reflect the restored framework.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支、弹药及相关零部件在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可与标识要求。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及手枪（HS 9302/9303）的企业应重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外资格及最终用途/最终用户管制。原产于中国的货物仍适用301关税及HTS归类要求，实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制。应重新评估此前许可申请并更新合规程序以符合恢复后的框架。

checklist.task: Re-verify ECCN and license exception eligibility
checklist.desc: Confirm whether civilian firearms and parts now fall under relaxed EAR controls; document ECCN, license exception basis, and any remaining license requirements before shipment.

checklist.task: Entity List and restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all buyers, consignees, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists; retain screening records and end-use statements.
Map 10-digit HTS lines (9302/9303) against Section 301 lists; document country of origin and value build-up to quantify additional duty exposure for China-origin goods.

checklist.task: Update export license applications and records
checklist.desc: Review pending and prior license applications affected by the rescission; update internal compliance procedures, AES filings, and recordkeeping to reflect the restored rule.

checklist.task: Lead and hazardous material compliance check
checklist.desc: Verify ammunition and firearm components against US hazardous material and environmental restrictions where applicable before export clearance.
